origin.description: Duplicates each string a given number of times and concatenates the copies.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector of strings to duplicate.

arguments.name: times
arguments.text: An integer vector of repetition counts.

origin.details: Vectorized over both arguments. A missing string, a missing count, or a negative count gives a missing result. A count of zero gives an empty string. If either argument has length zero, the result has length zero. The result length is the longer argument, with a warning when that length is not a multiple of the shorter one.

translation.description: Duplicates each string a given number of times and concatenates the copies.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, None, or a list, tuple, or range of strings, numbers, logicals, and missing values.

arguments.name: times
arguments.text: An integer count, or a list, tuple, or range of counts. Floats are truncated toward zero. A count outside the 32-bit range is missing.

translation.details: A missing string, a missing count, or a negative count stays missing. Zero repeats an empty string. None as a whole argument is an empty vector. The string NA is duplicated like any other string. Lengths recycle to the longer one, and a length that does not divide the result warns.
translation.value: A list of strings. Missing results are NA.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.join import stri_dup
print(stri_dup(["a", NA], 2))
